comments.content: The original code `std::string(RESOURCEDIR).c_str()` was intentionally truncating at the first null character to work around Conda injecting null characters (issue #6892). Changing it to `std::string(RESOURCEDIR)` removes that workaround and may reintroduce the bug. The same applies to `getLibraryDir()` and `getHelpDir()`.

The new code leaks `buf` when `_NSGetExecutablePath` fails (returns non-zero), because `delete[] buf` is only executed inside the success branch. The original code had the same issue, but since this line is being modified, it would be good to fix it by deleting `buf` unconditionally.
